title: Smoked Fish Tiradito
description: A Peruvian-inspired dish featuring smoked fish, mixed with citrus and spices.

ingredients.name: Warmly smoked fish (such as trout or salmon)
Tiradito seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Latin American markets

instructions: Combine thinly sliced red onion and chopped aji amarillo peppers in a bowl.
Add freshly squeezed lime juice and mix well.
Grate smoked fish over the mixture and toss to combine.
Season with tiradito seasoning blend and mix well.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil, if desired.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional chopped aji amarillo peppers, if desired.
